text:
This looks like a small plate, probably a side plate of about 20-22 cm, with 3 or 4 strips of dark glazed bacon and a small portion of broccoli.

Bacon: the strips are long and thin, and each cooked strip weighs about 8-10 g. Four strips come to about 35 g. Cooked bacon runs about 4.5 kcal/g, so that is roughly 160 kcal. The glaze may add a little more, so I'll say 170 kcal.

Broccoli: about 60 g at 0.35 kcal/g is about 20 kcal. It may have some oil on it, so I'll say 30 kcal.

Total: about 95 g of food and about 200 kcal.
